div.head: Nor Grið 8
div.ab: wifum and wæpnum. And cyricgrið dyre
[Schluss von 3.] Und Kirchen-Friedenschutz schätze [man] hoch überall nach dem Range [der Kirche] über das ganze Reich hin.
[End of clause 3.] 4. And let [one] value church peace-protection highly everywhere, according to the rank [of the church], throughout the whole kingdom.
weapons. And Church sanctuary is to be respected
div.note: Clause 4 runs over lines 8–9. Only ‘d’ of ‘dyre’ is visible, with rather ‘e’ behind it, per Warner; perhaps ‘deore’. Liebermann supplies ‘man’.; U: corrected against Rabin p. 33, October 2026 (was “[4]”, now “∅”)
dyre æghwar: Liebermann supplies man after dyre
Rabin’s 4 covers the rows 8, 9; it is given here, in the first.
